newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears builder Izolacja stock for trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears builder Izolacja stock for trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared for public trade shares in the construction firm Izolacja SA, which plans a December initial public offering and to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
"Izolacja shares have been cleared for public trade," KPW head Jacek Socha told a news conference on Thursday.

The firm is offering investors 100,130 shares from December 9 to December 13, with 70,130 shares needed to be sold for the issue to be valid and investors allowed to register for up to 350 shares. The KPW also cleared for trade all of Izolacja's remaining 1,049,870 shares.
Its main shareholders are National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 9 in Poland's mass privatisation programme, which holds 33 percent, and the state treasury, which holds 25.3 percent.
Jerzy Loch, President of NFI No. 9, declined to give a prospective price for the stock at the offering.
Izolacja, which specialises in building roofs for residential housing, made a net profit of 8.4 million zlotys last year on sales of 93.1 million zlotys.
It netted 3.1 million zlotys over this year's first half on sales of 41 million zlotys.
